purpose: Learning line for the past tense of weak verbs ('t kofschip) in years 4-6.
details: Plain stems first, then d/t/vz stems in year 6; persons and patterns grow. Loaded by kern/leerlijnen.py (laad/parameters) which the topic's generator calls with the child's school year; checked by tests/test_leerlijnen.py and turned into the handbook tables by docs/tools/handleiding.py.

field_notes.explanation: The stored skill id this learning line belongs to; the same as the file name. Stored ids are never renamed.
A short Dutch description of the skill (shown in the handbook and reports).
Goals of the skill (a list; empty for most skills).
The parameters of this skill and their type name (lijst, int, bool, tekst, getal); a value of the leerlijn must match.
Per school year (3, 4, 5, 6, m1, m2) the parameter values; a missing or null year means the skill is not offered then (the level cannot be chosen).
The difficulty levels (1, 2, 3) of the verbs that occur in that year.
The kinds of stem ending that occur (gewoon, d, t, vz = voiced/unvoiced).
The persons (ik, jij, jij_inv = jij after the verb, hij, mv) that occur.
Whether the step-by-step scheme is the default (false = typing the form directly).
